Mike Barratt beat Bill Kerr in the two mile but our supporting cast of North (elder) O'Hara, Black and Walker ensured victory in the team contest.

Untroubled throughout, he moved away from the field just as he pleased and beat the redoubtable Mike Barratt into 4th place. With Trevor Hart also beating Barratt, the hopes of our two runners were high for the Middlesex Champs. just two weeks hence.
(Under 21yrs) S.Edmunds (Sale) 23:09, A.Major (BELS) 23:17 PONDERS END - Fastest times:- Gerry North 16:57, Geoff North 17:04, M.Barratt(Ealing)17:08

Ealing, by virtue of an excellent run by Mike Barratt, had taken a short lived lead. Bryan Buxton was our runner on stage 6 and through inexperience of this form of running set off far to fast and paid the penalty during the later part of the leg.

Gerry North on the first of the long stages was well chased by Mike Barratt of Ealing but kept us in first place with a lead of 14 secs. Dave Holt gained a little ground for Hercules who were still third.
He finished sixth in a good class field 51 seconds behind winner M. Absolem and 4 seconds behind M.

Laurie O'Hara ran the fastest stage beating his old rival Mike Barratt by 2 seconds and picking up a bottle of wine in the process. All prizes were liquid and alcoholic and no doubt this will continue to remain a popular event with Belgrave's maturer runners.
Now 47 Laurie seems to get faster as the years go by and took the vets prize 43 seconds ahead of Mike Barratt. 1.B.Ford, Ald.F & D. 23.05; 2.Gren Tuck, Camb. + C. 23.30.
Times: Stage 1. 1.D.Crookes 11.34; 2.P.O'Connor 10.31; 3.W.Laws 11.39; 4.L.O'Hara 10.30; 5.K.Sinclair 11.49. Fastest Times: L.O'Hara 10.30; P.O'Connor 10.31; M.Barratt (E & S) 10.40.

In the O.50's Mike Barratt had a fairly easy victory over Laurie Ohara who is gradually returning to form after last years injury. Bels team victory was a popular one on a new and testing course set by John Wasbrough.
Perhaps the best performance of the day, however, was in the earlier Vets' race when Tony Simmons took 23 seconds off Mike Barratt's Veterans' lap record to record an amazing 16:18.
